note: Each case is a mutation of kafka-consumer-state-capture.example.json (R12: of the registrations). All are rejected; prior accepted state is preserved; no diagnostic echoes a rejected value.

cases.mutation: group_scope differs from the allow-list, or groups[] contains a group outside the allow-list
an allow-listed group has no entry in groups[]
a group state is unknown or missing
complete is false, or any group entry carries an acquisition error or a not-found/lookup failure instead of a broker-reported state
a field named like a credential (for example sasl.jaas.config) or a canary value is present; the value is never echoed
a required field is missing or mistyped, or captured_at is not RFC 3339 UTC
two registrations share broker_id and environment and an allow-listed group
groups[] contains two entries with the same group_id (or group_scope repeats an id)
captured_at is earlier than the latest accepted capture of this source
captured_at equals the latest accepted capture but the normalized content differs
